description: Audit the three weak signals (permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety) whose enrichment_v2 modules were recently built but still show only 4 distinct values. Script reads from mcp_signal_enrichments using write_service, queries cardinality per signal_type, and outputs a discrimination report. If any enrichment_v2 module produces fewer than 10 distinct scores across the corpus, propose a targeted calibration directive referencing the specific module and its weak field usage. This prevents context_efficiency_enrichment from being blocked by the deferral rule unnecessarily. References: Appendix B context_efficiency_enrichment deferral condition.
